newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mars Engineering seeks TSE listing.
newsitem.headline: Mars Engineering seeks TSE listing.

text.p: The Tokyo Stock Exchange said on Monday that Mars Engineering Corp, a manufacturer of systems which manage prizes for pinball parlours, has applied to list in its second section.
The company is expected to be listed on September 13, the exchange said in its statement.
Mars Engineering, established in September 1974, has been listed on the over-the-counter market since November 1993.
The company posted sales of 17.4 billion yen and current profits of 3.9 billion in 1995/96 fiscal year. It expects sales to reach 21 billion yen in the current fiscal year.
